title: Transfer Between Stage and Limit Oracles
statement: Let $(N_j)_{j\ge0}$ be a sequence of finite-state oracle Turing machines, let $i$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $y$ be a Boolean string. Running $N_i$ with the union of all stage-positive sets as oracle on the unary input of length $n_i$ halts within $n_i^i+i$ steps with output $y$ if and only if running it with the stage-$i$ positive-set oracle on that same input halts within the same number of steps with output $y$, where $n_i$ is the fresh length chosen for stage $i$.
hypotheses_covered: A sequence of finite-state oracle Turing machines N
